# Baiden Creatives

> Baiden Creatives is a digital creative studio based in East Legon, Accra, Ghana, offering web development, web design and graphic design for businesses, organisations, entrepreneurs and individuals across Ghana. Tagline: "Your business. Digitally elevated."

Founders: Baiden David and Baiden Daniel.
Website: https://baiden-creatives.vercel.app/

Location: East Legon, Accra, Greater Accra Region, Ghana.
Service area: Ghana (projects can be delivered remotely). Language: English. Currency: Ghana cedi (GHS).

## Services
- Web development: business and corporate websites, e-commerce, booking systems, client portals, dashboards, custom web applications.
- Web design: UI/UX design, responsive mobile-first layouts, landing pages, website redesign.
- Graphic design: flyers, posters, social media graphics, business cards, brand design.
- Launch setup: domain, hosting, SSL/HTTPS, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, sitemap, performance optimisation.

## Pricing (starting guides, GHS)
- Starter website (1-3 pages): GH₵2,500, 5-7 working days.
- Business website (up to 7 pages, analytics, SEO, 30 days support): GH₵5,000, 1-3 weeks.
- Professional website (up to 12 pages, CMS, booking, 60 days support): GH₵8,500, 2-4 weeks.
- E-commerce website (Mobile Money and card payments, admin dashboard): from GH₵10,000, 3-6 weeks.
- Custom web application: from GH₵15,000, quoted after assessment.
- Payment: under GH₵10,000 is 60% upfront and 40% before launch; larger projects 50% / 30% / 20%.
- Extras not automatically included: domain and hosting renewals, paid plugins/APIs, stock images, photography, copywriting, payment gateway fees, changes outside the agreed scope.

## FAQ
- Where are you based? East Legon, Accra, Ghana. We serve clients across Ghana and can work remotely.
- How does payment work? Under GH₵10,000: 60% upfront, 40% before launch. Larger projects: 50% / 30% / 20%.
- What is not included? Domain and hosting renewals, premium plugins, paid APIs, stock images, photography, copywriting, gateway charges and out-of-scope changes.
- What happens at launch? Domain, hosting, SSL, mobile optimisation, testing and deployment; Business and Professional also include Google Analytics, Search Console and a sitemap.
- What do I need to provide? Logo, images, business information, contact details, social links and content.
